source: Pinned Minecraft Bedrock 1.21.5 assets in scripts/training/mc_frontier_assets/resource_pack/textures/blocks/; reference model: Minecraft Java block/template_sculk_shrieker.json
method: Retain the original 128x128 orthographic camera, lighting and nearest-pixel rasterizer. Project the lower slab at height 0-8 with the full animated inner top and side UV 8-16; project the hollow upper frame at 8-15 with the transparent corner top, outer faces and two interior-facing walls. Preserve transparent pixels and z-buffer occlusion.
